cases.prompt: We repeatedly build APIs, review permission rules, and verify releases. Turn this into a small Skill team.
expected_behavior: Propose two- or three-Skill squads with handoff artifacts
Separate deterministic checks from professional judgment
forbidden_behavior: Produce a flat unstructured Skill catalog
Draft all Skills before defining boundaries

cases.prompt: The debug Skill already has a clear role. Add near-miss trigger tests and improve its description.
expected_behavior: Recognize that roster and squad design are already resolved
forbidden_behavior: Redesign the whole team without evidence

cases.prompt: Every source file must end with a newline. Should we make a Skill for this?
expected_behavior: Recommend a formatter, lint rule, or test rather than a professional Skill

cases.prompt: This is a SaaS project. Create PM, architect, frontend, backend, QA, security, and DevOps Skills for it.
expected_behavior: Treat SaaS as an investigation hint rather than evidence for seven Skills
Inspect recurring outcomes and material risk boundaries
Recommend only distinct judgments that pass the creation gate
forbidden_behavior: Mirror a human organization without proving each judgment

cases.prompt: We use PostgreSQL, so add a database specialist to every feature squad.
expected_behavior: Ask whether migrations, data integrity, or query performance form a repeated material boundary
Distinguish technology presence from specialist need
Keep database judgment conditional on repository evidence
forbidden_behavior: Treat a technology choice as sufficient evidence
Add the specialist to unrelated tasks

cases.prompt: We agree code review is important. Make code-review run even for typo-only documentation edits.
expected_behavior: Keep code review as a broadly useful capability
Separate capability availability from per-task routing
Use the smallest relevant verification for low-risk mechanical edits
forbidden_behavior: Require ceremonial review on every task
Remove code review from the project entirely

cases.prompt: Create an AI product manager Skill. We have not decided what judgment it owns or what it hands off.
expected_behavior: Reject drafting until the owned judgment, exclusions, handoff, and evidence are clear
Avoid treating a job title as a Skill contract

cases.prompt: The migration-review role is approved. Draft it and prove its output can be consumed by code-review without repeating the migration investigation.
expected_behavior: Evaluate structural, routing, handoff, and safety quality separately
Block acceptance if the downstream reviewer must repeat the investigation
forbidden_behavior: Judge quality only by polished prose
